set.excerpt: Typical minimum admission grades ranges (out of 42 subject points; guideline only). Arts: no specific prerequisites, 33 to 36. Management: HL Mathematics (AA or AI) or SL Mathematics AA with 6 or 7; 35 to 38; Math 5 (HL) / 6 (SL AA). Engineering: Mathematics, Chemistry and Physics at HL or SL (at least one math/science at HL); Mechanical Engineering 38 to 42, each math & science 6. Science: Mathematics and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics, at least one math/science at HL; Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group 35 to 38, each math & science 5 to 6 (and at least one 6). The Diploma with grades of 5 or better on each Higher and Standard Level subject is the minimum expected for most programs. Science PREREQUISITES Mathematics and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics, at Higher or Standard Level; at least one math/science at HL Note : SL Math AI is not accepted. Biological, Biomedical and Life Sciences Group Predicted/Final (out of 42) : 36 to 39 subject points Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group Predicted/Final (out of 42) : 35 to 38 subject points Each math & science: 5 to 6 (and at least one 6); 6 if SL Math AA.

Typical minimum admission grades ranges (guideline only; minimum grades fluctuate year to year). Arts: minimum of three A-Levels in three different subjects, no specific prerequisites, AAA to ABB. Management: three A-Levels including A-Level Math, A*AA - AAB. Engineering: three A-Levels including at least two of A-Level Math, chemistry, or physics; Mechanical Engineering A*A*A - AAA. Science: three A-Levels including A-Level Math and at least one of biology, chemistry, or physics; Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group A*AA - ABB. Minimum of three A-Levels in three different subjects, including A-Level Math and at least one A-Level in biology, chemistry, or physics; Biology, chemistry, math and physics at GCSE level Biological, Biomedical and Life Sciences Group Predicted/Final A-Levels: A*AA - AAB Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group Predicted/Final A-Levels: A*AA - ABB
